column1: ## Repository Table R6. Distinct-sequence abundance profile

## Description: Source-export rank-abundance profile. This table is a displayed profile, not one row for every globally unique training string; full singleton fractions derive from the corpus summary.
## Missing values: NA means unavailable or not applicable, never a zero score. Numeric values retain source precision.
## Column 1 | Abundance rank | Abundance rank for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 2 | Occurrence count | Occurrence count for the observation defined in the table description.
